name: Mojave Desert Acoustic Sanctuary
description: An isolated desert research compound equipped with ground-coupled geophones, wideband VLF radio loops, and acoustic wind-sheltered microphone pods. Serves as a primary test bed for low-noise environmental recording and long-range acoustic propagation studies.
publicAccessProtocol: Restricted field station; open to visiting sound artists by seasonal fellowship.

name: Svalbard Arctic Hydrophone Array
description: An Arctic hydrophone and seismometer string lowered into sub-glacial wells and fjord waters to track acoustic calving, sea-ice fracture dynamics, and marine mammal vocalizations.
publicAccessProtocol: Open scientific data stream accessible via university research network.

name: Salton Basin Subterranean Acoustic Vault
description: A subterranean concrete installation vault featuring an 18.4-second natural acoustic reverberation time. Utilized for extreme acoustic feedback tests, high-order ambisonic sound staging, and physical modeling calibration.
publicAccessProtocol: Classified engineering test site; access managed by ZIAA Director of Research.

name: Atacama Infrasound Array
description: An ultra-low frequency micro-barometer array situated at 4,200 meters elevation in the high Andes, monitoring atmospheric waves, volcanic rumbles, and stratospheric wind shears.
publicAccessProtocol: Real-time infrasound telemetry published to international geophysical archives.

name: Kallio Granite Resonant Cavern
description: A solid bedrock granite chamber carved into Finnish shield rock, used for physical lithophone testing, stone resonance analysis, and acoustic boundary reflections.
publicAccessProtocol: Open for sound artist residencies during biennial creative workshops.

name: Orford Ness Coastal Listening Pavilion
description: A coastal architectural sound pavilion exploring ocean wave reflection, wind excitation of structural concrete cavities, and maritime signal archaeology.
publicAccessProtocol: Open to the public during scheduled summer listening sessions.

name: Kyoto Bamboo Canopy Listening Post
description: A solar-powered canopy listening node sonifying natural wind friction across bamboo stalks, ultrasonic insect calls, and seasonal rain dynamics.
publicAccessProtocol: Live audio stream broadcast via ZIAA creative web portal.

name: Cascadia Tectonic Listening Array
description: Deep borehole geophones capturing sub-audible crustal vibrations, translated via algorithmic pitch transposition into audible musical ranges in real time.
publicAccessProtocol: Data fed directly into the ZIAA Generative Composition and DSP Bench.

name: Reykjavik Geothermal Acoustic Rig
physicalFootprint: Direct coupling to geothermal borehole bypass
description: High-temperature transducers mounted to geothermal wellheads, capturing the roaring acoustic pressure of pressurized volcanic steam and underground boiling brine.
publicAccessProtocol: Collaborative research with Icelandic energy and sound art institutions.

name: Berlin Teufelsberg Geodesic Listening Lab
description: A radome structure featuring extraordinary acoustic echo and multi-path flutter characteristics. Utilized for spatial ambisonic diffusion and acoustic impulse response profiling.
publicAccessProtocol: Open for artistic sound performances by invitation.

name: Bermuda Oceanic SOFAR Sound Station
description: Deep-ocean hydrophone station moored within the oceanic SOFAR channel, capturing low-frequency acoustic signals traveling thousands of kilometers across the Atlantic basin.
publicAccessProtocol: Open data for marine sound research and spatial sonification projects.

name: Joshua Tree Natural Radio Pod
location: Joshua Tree National Park, California, USA
description: Radio listening station tuned to naturally occurring VLF emissions—lightning whistlers, dawn chorus, and magnetospheric chirps—without artificial power grid interference.
publicAccessProtocol: Real-time audio feed streamed to ZIAA Spectral Lab for creative resynthesis.

name: Gotthard Base Tunnel Acoustic Duct
description: An elongated subterranean acoustic waveguide used for studying one-dimensional planar sound propagation, low-frequency wave reflection, and boundary layer attenuation.
publicAccessProtocol: Access restricted to scheduled maintenance windows.

name: Namib Dune Singing Sand Observatory
physicalFootprint: Linear array across slip-face of Dune 45
description: Specialized seismic and acoustic array recording the low-frequency acoustic drone ('singing sands') produced by synchronized shear avalanche motion of uniform quartz grains.
publicAccessProtocol: Research archive documentation open under Creative Commons attribution.

name: Edinburgh Vaults Spatial Sound Lab
description: Historic sandstone chamber network utilized for complex multi-room convolution reverb profiling and sound spatialization experiments.
publicAccessProtocol: Accessible for artist residencies and sound installation research.

name: Oahu Benthic Bio-Acoustic Array
description: Continuous underwater sound recording tracking coral reef health, snapping shrimp acoustic crackle, and seasonal humpback whale song migrations.
publicAccessProtocol: Live underwater audio stream and open bio-acoustic dataset.
